summary: The module equals settlement: truncated gross, half-up tax, and the D-18 zero payout. The locale blocks equal PR section 6 in en, th, and zh. The five gallery slots and the six D-19 page images are correct, and the 12 targeted test files pass (194 tests). One blocker stays: the graph row labelled graph.ownBar 'Your own students' shows the tutor's payout before tax (4,645.69 in preset 2, own volume 6,000). That misattributes a money figure against PR section 3. The fix needs a decision, because spec D-9 and a committed adversarial pin still require the bars to add up to the gross.
blocking_findings: A-P3-1 [Blocker] review-a: The graph row labelled graph.ownBar ('Your own students' / 'นักเรียนในคลาสของคุณเอง') shows result.preTax, the tutor's payout before tax after the leg commissions (apps/www-reading-advantage/src/components/marketing/tutor-commission-calculator.tsx:403-415). In preset 2 the row reads 'Your own students 4,645.69', but the own volume is 6,000 and 4,645.69 is the rate on the whole network volume minus the leg commissions. PR handoff section 3 line 123 says the graph 'shows the tutor's own students as one bar, the gross at the tutor's rate, and the payout after the leg commissions and the 3% tax'. PR section 8.1 line 307 maps the old tutor payout row (chart.yourPayout) to graph.netBar, not to ownBar. Judgment on open item (a): reject. The fix needs a decision: spec D-9 (spec.md:238-256) still names the chart.* keys and says the bars add up to the gross, and the committed adversarial case 'the graph bars add up to the whole gross' (tutor-commission-calculator.adversarial.test.tsx:328-344) pins the third bar to preTax/gross. Disposition proposal: ESCALATE for the graph decision; after the decision, Red changes D-9 and the pin, and Green changes the own row.
